requirements.title: A note is taken, kept and handed to the next session
requirements.rationale: A person who sees an item going the wrong way must be able to say so without stopping it, and what they said must not be lost between sessions.

criteria.condition: an authenticated client sends `POST /api/v1/items/{number}/notes` with a body `{"text"}` whose text has 1 to 20,000 Unicode code points, for an item in the state `new`, `planning`, `ready`, `implementing` or `reviewing`
criteria.action: store a note with the next id (starting at 1, never given twice), the item, the text as given and the clock's time; hand it over as a finding of the person, for an item that is `new` or `planning` with package 05's `plan.Service.AddFinding(ctx, item, text)` and for one that is `ready`, `implementing` or `reviewing` with package 06's `impl.Service.Rework(ctx, item, [{ID: "note-<id>", Source: "person", Text: text}])`; append to the item's thread an entry of kind `note` whose text is the note's text, not marking the thread unread; and end no session and close no decision
criteria.contract: status 201 with the note `{id, item, text, time, delivered: null}`; a session of the item that was running still runs; exactly one of `AddFinding` and `Rework` was called, once, and neither `Revise` nor `Withdraw`; an item of kind `spec` in `new`, for which `AddFinding` answers `plan.ErrNotPlanning`, keeps the note and has it handed over with `Rework` when the item becomes `ready`; `nightshift item note <N> "<text>"` prints `note <id> added to item <N>` and exits 0, and with `--json` prints the API's answer

setup: a note service over a copy of the store template of internal/store, a real item service and inbox, an injected clock, and recording stubs for the three interfaces the service calls: the planner (package 05's AddFinding and Revise, and the count of its pending findings of the person), the implementer (package 06's Rework and History) and the lander (package 07's Withdraw)
a test helper that puts an item into any state by walking allowed transitions, as internal/item's tests do

One row, a spec item in new with AddFinding answering plan.ErrNotPlanning: 201, no Rework; then itemSvc.Transition(n, 'ready'); assert Rework(n, [{ID: 'note-1', …}]) once. In internal/cli/cli_test.go (package 01's file), against an httptest server: ['item','note','7','Keep the old log line'] -> code 0, stdout 'note 1 added to item 7\n', the request body {text}; with --json stdout is the answer

criteria.condition: a note request carries a body that is not a JSON object with a string `text`, a text of 0 or of more than 20,000 Unicode code points, a number that is not a positive decimal integer, or the number of no item
criteria.action: refuse the request and store nothing
criteria.contract: status 400 `invalid_request` with the message `text must be 1 to 20,000 characters` for the text, and 400 `invalid_request` for the body and the number; status 404 `not_found` for the unknown item; no note, no entry and no event is written; `nightshift item note` with a missing argument, a third argument, a number that is no positive integer, or a text outside the bounds exits 2 with the usage on stderr and sends no request

criteria.condition: a note names an item in the state `verifying`, `publishing`, `done` or `abandoned`
criteria.action: refuse the note and store nothing
criteria.contract: status 409 with `error_type` `conflict` and the message `item <N> has landed; create a new item`; `nightshift item note` exits 1 with that message on stderr; no note and no entry is written and no stub was called

In internal/cli/cli_test.go: the server answers that 409 -> code 1, stderr 'item 7 has landed; create a new item\n'

criteria.action: for any item, answer `Pending(ctx, item)` of the note service with the item's notes that are not delivered, in ascending order of id, which is the order they were given in, and answer `Pending(ctx, item)` of the findings source (`Service.Source()`) with the texts of those notes in that order and the id of the last one
criteria.contract: an item with no pending note answers an empty list and the id 0; notes of another item are never among them; a note stays pending across a restart of nightshiftd

criteria.condition: the event log delivers a `session.ended` event of a completed planner or implementer session of an item that has pending notes, and the package the notes were handed to no longer holds them as waiting: package 06's `History(item)` holds the finding `note-<id>` of a note handed to the implementer, or package 05 reports no pending finding of the person for an item whose notes were handed to the planner
criteria.action: call `MarkDelivered(ctx, item, through, session)`, the function behind `Delivered` of the findings source, which marks every pending note of the item whose id is at most `through` as delivered to that session at the clock's time and appends to the item's thread one entry of kind `note_delivered` with the text `note <id>[, <id>…] given to session <session>`, not marking the thread unread
criteria.contract: those notes are no longer answered by `Pending` and carry `delivered` `{session, time}`; a note the package still holds as waiting stays pending and is marked with the session that carries it; a session that failed or was interrupted marks nothing; a second call of `MarkDelivered` with the same arguments, a `through` of 0 and a call for an item with nothing pending write nothing and return nil

requirements.title: What a note starts, by the item's state
requirements.rationale: A note is only worth giving when a session is certain to read it, so every state before the landing must lead to one.

criteria.condition: an implementer session of an item ends while a note of the item waits, also when the gate would pass on its version and the reviewer would agree; or the first implementer session of a `ready` item starts while a note waits
criteria.action: give the waiting notes to the item's next implementer session as binding findings of the person, in the order given: to a first implementation in an input of their own beside the package, to a rework in its findings, starting a rework for them alone when nothing else waits; and have the version of the session that carried them gated and reviewed
criteria.contract: the item does not reach `landing` while a note of it waits; the session's input holds each waiting note's text with the source `person`; the running session was not interrupted for the note; the note is marked delivered to the session that carried it

criteria.condition: a note is given to an item in the state `awaiting_approval`
criteria.action: store the note, call package 05's `plan.Service.Revise(ctx, item, text)`, which stores the text as a pending finding of the person and moves the item to `planning` so that the planner runs once more on the draft, close every open decision of the item of the kind `plan` through the inbox's `Close` with the reason `superseded by a note`, and append the `note` entry
criteria.contract: status 201 with the note; `Revise` was called once with the note's text, and `AddFinding` not at all; the former `plan` decision has the state `closed` and the `closed_reason` `superseded by a note` and is no longer in `Action`; a decision of the item of another kind stays open

check.pseudocode: in internal/note/routes_test.go: item 7 in awaiting_approval with an open decision of a kind 'plan' the test declares and an open decision of a test kind; r = post('/api/v1/items/7/notes', {text: 'Use the existing config key'}); assert r.status == 201; assert the planner stub saw Revise(7, 'Use the existing config key') once and no AddFinding; assert inbox.Decision(plan).State == 'closed' and ClosedReason == 'superseded by a note'; assert the other decision is open; assert the thread's entries end with decision_closed then note

criteria.condition: a planner round of an item starts while a note of the item waits, or the reviewer of a plan agrees while one waits
criteria.action: give the waiting notes to the planner as findings of the person which it must follow, in the order given, run one more planner round for them when the reviewer had agreed already, and end planning only when no note waits
criteria.contract: a `plan` decision opens, or the item becomes `ready` without one, only after the round that was given the notes; the planner's findings input holds each waiting note's text with the source `person`; the notes are marked delivered to that round's session

criteria.condition: a note is given to an item in the state `landing`
criteria.action: call package 07's `land.Service.Withdraw(ctx, item, "note from the owner")`, which waits until no land of the item is being answered and reports the check `nightshift-release` as `failed` with that summary; then store the note, call package 06's `impl.Service.Rework(ctx, item, [{ID: "note-<id>", Source: "person", Text: text}])`, which moves the item to `implementing` and keeps the finding for its next session, close every open decision of the item with the reason `superseded by a note`, and append the `note` entry
criteria.contract: status 201 with the note; `Withdraw` returned before anything was stored; every decision of the item that was open has the state `closed`

check.pseudocode: in internal/note/routes_test.go: item 7 in landing with an open decision of a kind 'approval' the test declares; the stubs record the order of their calls and the count of stored notes at each: r = post('/api/v1/items/7/notes', {text: 'Keep the old log line'}); assert r.status == 201; assert the call order == [Withdraw(7, 'note from the owner') with 0 notes stored, Rework(7, [{ID: 'note-1', Source: 'person', Text: 'Keep the old log line'}]) with 1 stored]; assert the approval decision's state == 'closed' and ClosedReason == 'superseded by a note'; assert the thread's last entry is the note

criteria.condition: a note is given to an item whose landing waits for the person's approval
criteria.action: have the hub hold the check `nightshift-release` as `failed` with the summary `note from the owner` on the version that waited, start a rework of the item with the note, and have the rework's version gated and reviewed again
criteria.contract: the hub's change has a newer version after the rework; the version that waited never lands

criteria.condition: `Withdraw` answers `land.ErrLanded` for a note to an item in `landing`
criteria.action: refuse the note as for an item that is `verifying`, and store nothing
criteria.contract: status 409 with `error_type` `conflict` and the message `item <N> has landed; create a new item`; no note and no entry is written, no decision is closed and `Rework` is not called

check.pseudocode: in internal/note/routes_test.go: item 7 in landing with an open decision, the lander stub's Withdraw returns land.ErrLanded: r = post('/api/v1/items/7/notes', {text: 'x'}); assert r.status == 409 and r.json.message == 'item 7 has landed; create a new item'; assert count(notes) == 0; assert the decision is open; assert Rework was not called

criteria.condition: `Withdraw` fails with another error than `land.ErrLanded`, or `AddFinding` (with another error than `plan.ErrNotPlanning`), `Revise` or `Rework` returns an error
criteria.action: refuse the note, remove it where it was stored, write no entry and close no decision
criteria.contract: status 503 `hub_unavailable` while the hub client's `Available(worker)` is false; else, for `Withdraw`, 502 `hub_error` with the error's first line as the message, and for the three others 500 `internal`; `Pending` answers no note of the request; the item's open decisions are still open; the `nightshift` command exits 1 with the message on stderr; the same request sent again when the cause is gone is accepted

check.pseudocode: in internal/note/routes_test.go, a table over {landing, Withdraw fails and Available false -> 503 hub_unavailable; landing, Withdraw fails with 'checks: 500 boom\nmore' and Available true -> 502 hub_error 'checks: 500 boom'; landing, Rework fails -> 500 internal; implementing, Rework fails -> 500; planning, AddFinding fails -> 500; awaiting_approval, Revise fails -> 500; awaiting_approval, Revise fails and Available false -> 503}: assert r.status and r.json.error_type; assert len(svc.Pending(ctx, 7)) == 0; assert the entry count is unchanged; assert the open decision is still open; then let the stub succeed and post again: assert 201

requirements.title: Taking an item over with the command
requirements.rationale: When the agents do not get an item right, the person must be able to do it themselves on the item's own branch, with nightshift out of the way.

criteria.condition: an authenticated client sends `POST /api/v1/items/{number}/take-over` for an item that has a change, is in the state `planning`, `awaiting_approval`, `ready`, `implementing`, `reviewing` or `landing` and is not taken over, while the hub answers
criteria.action: read the item's fork, branch and git URL from package 05's `change.Service.Get(ctx, item)` and the number of the change's current version from package 06's `impl.Service.Version(ctx, item)`; store the take-over with the item, that version, the time and how it came (`command`); hold the item with `Scheduler.HoldItem`, which ends its running session, recorded as interrupted; close the item's open decisions of the kinds `session_failed`, `session_limit`, `review_disagreement`, `conflict` and `blocked` with the reason `taken over`; append to the item's thread an entry of kind `taken_over` with the text `taken over at version <n>; push to branch <branch> of <git URL>, then run nightshift item resume <N>`, not marking the thread unread; and append the event `item.updated`
criteria.contract: status 200 with `{item, git_url, branch, version}`, the item's `markers` holding `taken over`; the item's state is unchanged; an open decision of another kind stays open; `nightshift item take-over <N>` prints the three lines `item <N> taken over`, `git <git URL>` and `branch <branch>` and exits 0, and with `--json` prints the API's answer

setup: a take-over service over a copy of the store template, a real item service and inbox, an injected clock, and stubs: a change source answering package 05's Record {Workspace 'demo', Fork 'demo--i7', GitURL 'https://hub.example/git/acme/demo--i7.git', Branch 'item-7', Change 4} or change.ErrNotFound, a version source answering package 06's impl.Version with Number 3 or an error, and a holder recording HoldItem calls

git https://hub.example/git/acme/demo--i7.git

'

criteria.condition: an item is taken over
criteria.action: report the marker `taken over` for it unless it is `abandoned`, keep its pause flag set so that no step function is called for it, no session starts for it and it is not landed, answer false from the landing condition `taken over` registered with package 07's `land.Service.AddCondition`, and start nothing when the hub records a new version of its change
criteria.contract: `GET /api/v1/items/{number}` and `GET /api/v1/items` carry `taken over` in `markers`, and `nightshift item show <N>` and `nightshift item list` print it; `Scheduler.Paused(item)` is true; a resume of the item's workspace leaves it held; the take-over and the hold survive a restart of nightshiftd; an abandoned item no longer carries the marker

criteria.condition: a take-over names an item that has no change yet (`change.Service.Get` answers `change.ErrNotFound` or a record whose `Change` is 0), an item in the state `verifying`, `publishing`, `done` or `abandoned`, an item that is taken over already, a number that is not a positive decimal integer, or the number of no item
criteria.action: refuse the take-over and change nothing
criteria.contract: status 409 with `error_type` `conflict` and the message `item <N> has no change yet`, `item <N> is <state>` or `item <N> is already taken over`; status 400 `invalid_request` for the malformed number and 404 `not_found` for the unknown item; no hub request was sent, nothing is stored, the item is not held and its running session still runs; `nightshift item take-over` exits 1 with the message on stderr, and exits 2 without a request when the argument is missing or no positive integer

criteria.condition: the change's current version cannot be read for a take-over: the hub client's `Available(worker)` is false, or `impl.Service.Version` returns an error
criteria.action: refuse the take-over and change nothing
criteria.contract: status 503 `hub_unavailable` while `Available(worker)` is false; else status 502 `hub_error` with the error's first line as the message; nothing is stored, `HoldItem` is not called, no decision is closed and no entry is written

criteria.condition: a part of nightshift calls `Scheduler.HoldItem(ctx, item)` for an item that is neither `done` nor `abandoned`
criteria.action: where the item's own pause flag is not set, set it, also while the pause flag of its workspace is set, cancel the item's running step, end its running session and record that session as `interrupted`, call the functions registered with `OnPause` and append the event `item.updated`; where the item's own flag is set already, change nothing
criteria.contract: the call returns nil in both cases; `Scheduler.Paused(item)` is true; `POST /api/v1/items/{number}/resume` of package 04 clears the flag as it clears one its pause route set; a resume of the workspace does not; an unknown item returns `item.ErrNotFound` and a `done` or `abandoned` one an error, each setting nothing

requirements.title: The option `take_over` of five decision kinds
requirements.rationale: The moments at which a person most wants to take an item over are the ones at which nightshift already asks them something.

criteria.condition: nightshiftd wires its packages at start, after the packages that declare the decision kinds `session_failed`, `session_limit`, `review_disagreement`, `blocked` and `conflict` have declared them
criteria.action: add to each of the five kinds, through the inbox's `AddOption`, the option with the key `take_over`, the line `hands the item's branch to you; nothing runs for it until you resume it` and no required comment, and register for each kind and that option, through the inbox's `OnAnswer`, the handler that takes the item over
criteria.contract: a decision of any of the five kinds opened afterwards lists `take_over` after the options its kind was declared with, not recommended unless the opener names it; `POST /api/v1/decisions/{id}/answer` with `{"option": "take_over"}` is accepted without a comment

setup: a take-over service over a copy of the store template, a real item service and inbox, an injected clock, and stubs: a change source answering package 05's Record {Workspace 'demo', Fork 'demo--i7', GitURL 'https://hub.example/git/acme/demo--i7.git', Branch 'item-7', Change 4} or change.ErrNotFound, a version source answering package 06's impl.Version with Number 3 or an error, and a holder recording HoldItem calls
check.pseudocode: new file internal/takeover/decision_test.go, with a real inbox on which the test declares the five kinds with the options their packages give them (session_failed: retry, abandon; session_limit: continue, abandon; review_disagreement: side_with_reviewer, side_with_implementer, abandon; blocked: revise, abandon; conflict: retry, abandon): err = svc.RegisterOption(inbox); assert err == nil; a table over the five kinds: d = inbox.Open(ctx, {Kind: kind, Thread: t, Question: 'q', Recommended: first option}); assert the last of d.Options == {key: 'take_over', does: "hands the item's branch to you; nothing runs for it until you resume it", comment_required: false, recommended: false}; assert post('/api/v1/decisions/' + d.ID + '/answer', {option: 'take_over'}).status == 200

criteria.condition: one of the five kinds is not declared when the option is added
criteria.action: fail the start of nightshiftd and start nothing
criteria.contract: `RegisterOption` returns an error whose text is `take_over: decision kind "<kind>" is not declared`, naming the first missing kind in the order `session_failed`, `session_limit`, `review_disagreement`, `blocked`, `conflict`; nightshiftd writes that line to stderr and exits with code 1 without listening

check.pseudocode: in internal/takeover/decision_test.go: an inbox with only session_failed and session_limit declared: err = svc.RegisterOption(inbox); assert err.Error() == 'take_over: decision kind "review_disagreement" is not declared'. In internal/daemon/start_test.go (package 01's file): run the daemon with a wiring hook that leaves out the declaration of 'conflict'; assert exit code 1, stderr ends with 'take_over: decision kind "conflict" is not declared\n' and the listen address refuses a connection

criteria.condition: a decision of one of the five kinds is answered `take_over` for an item that has a change and is not taken over, while the hub answers
criteria.action: take the item over as the command does: read the fork's git URL, the branch and the current version, store the take-over with how it came (`decision <id>`), hold the item, and append the `taken_over` entry and the event `item.updated`
criteria.contract: the handler returns nil, within the 5 seconds the inbox gives an answer; the item's `markers` hold `taken over`; its running session, if any, ended as `interrupted`; the item's other open decisions stay open; an item that was paused already is taken over at once; a second call of the handler for the same answer, and an answer for an item that is taken over already, store nothing, write no entry and return nil

check.pseudocode: in internal/takeover/decision_test.go, a table over the five kinds, and one row with the item paused before: open a decision of the kind on item 7's thread and one of a test kind; post the answer {option: 'take_over'}; eventually inbox.Pending() is empty; assert the holder saw HoldItem(7) once; assert the take-over row == {item 7, version 3, via 'decision <id>'}; assert the thread's last entry has the kind 'taken_over' and names the branch and the git URL; assert the test-kind decision is open; call the registered handler again with the same decision; assert count(take-overs) == 1 and the entry count is unchanged

criteria.condition: a decision is answered `take_over` for an item that has no change yet
criteria.action: append to the item's thread an entry of kind `take_over_refused` with the text `take-over refused: item <N> has no change yet`, marking the thread unread, and, unless a decision of that kind is open for the item, open through the inbox's `Open` a new decision of the answered one's kind with its question, its evidence, its recommended option and its `blocks`
criteria.contract: the handler returns nil; the item is not held and not taken over; the item's `waiting_on` names the new decision, whose options are the kind's, `take_over` among them; a second call of the handler for the same answer opens no second decision

criteria.action: return an error from the handler and change nothing, so that the inbox calls the handler again

requirements.title: Giving an item back with `item resume`
requirements.rationale: Taking over is a detour, not an exit: what the person pushed has to pass what an agent's work passes, and an item they did not touch has to go on where it stood.

criteria.condition: package 04's `POST /api/v1/items/{number}/resume` clears the pause flag of a taken-over item that is `implementing`, `reviewing` or `landing`, and the number of the current version of its change (`impl.Service.Version`) is greater than the one stored at the take-over
criteria.action: in the function registered with `Scheduler.OnResume`: close every open decision of the item with the reason `superseded by version <n>`; end the take-over, storing the time and the version; append to the item's thread an entry of kind `given_back` with the text `given back with version <n> (taken over at version <m>); it is gated and reviewed`, not marking the thread unread; append the event `item.updated`; and start nothing itself, because the steps of packages 06 and 07 gate and review a current version that is not gated: package 06's `implementing` step evaluates and gates it, its `reviewing` step and package 07's `landing` step move the item to `implementing` for it
criteria.contract: the resume route answers as package 04 specifies, status 200 with the item, and `nightshift item resume <N>` prints `resumed item <N>`; afterwards the item's `markers` hold neither `paused` nor `taken over` and the item waits on no decision, so that the scheduler calls its step; no `Rework` is called; the take-over's row is kept with its end

setup: a take-over service over a copy of the store template, a real item service and inbox, an injected clock, and stubs: a change source answering package 05's Record {Workspace 'demo', Fork 'demo--i7', GitURL 'https://hub.example/git/acme/demo--i7.git', Branch 'item-7', Change 4} or change.ErrNotFound, a version source answering package 06's impl.Version with Number 3 or an error, and a holder recording HoldItem calls
check.pseudocode: new file internal/takeover/giveback_test.go, with a real scheduler whose resume route is registered, the take-over service's GiveBack registered with OnResume and a step function per state that counts its calls: a table over the three states, item 7 taken over at version 3 with an open decision of a kind 'approval' the test declares; the version stub answers 5: r = post('/api/v1/items/7/resume'); assert r.status == 200; assert the approval decision's ClosedReason == 'superseded by version 5'; assert the thread's last entry == {kind: 'given_back', text: 'given back with version 5 (taken over at version 3); it is gated and reviewed'}; assert get('/api/v1/items/7').json.markers == [] and waiting_on == null; pass; assert the state's step function was called once; assert the take-over row has given_back_at == clock and given_back_version == 5

criteria.condition: the resume clears the pause flag of a taken-over item whose change has no version newer than at the take-over, or of one that is `planning`, `awaiting_approval` or `ready`
criteria.action: end the take-over, storing the time and the version; append an entry of kind `given_back` with the text `given back; continuing with <state>`, or `given back with version <n>; continuing with <state>` where the version is newer; append the event `item.updated`; and call nothing else, so that the scheduler calls the step function of the item's state again
criteria.contract: no decision is closed; the item's `markers` hold neither `paused` nor `taken over`; the step function of the item's state is called at the next pass when the item waits on no decision

check.pseudocode: in internal/takeover/giveback_test.go, a table over {implementing, version still 3 -> 'given back; continuing with implementing'; landing, version 3 -> '…continuing with landing'; awaiting_approval with its open plan decision, version 5 -> 'given back with version 5; continuing with awaiting_approval'; ready, version 5; planning, version 3}: post('/api/v1/items/7/resume'); assert status 200; assert the open decision, where there is one, is still open; assert the thread's last entry text; assert the markers are empty; pass; assert the state's step function was called for the rows without an open decision

criteria.condition: the change's current version cannot be read when a taken-over item is resumed
criteria.action: end the take-over all the same, with no version, close no decision, and append the `given_back` entry with the text `given back; the hub could not be asked for the version; continuing with <state>`
criteria.contract: the resume route answers 200; the item is no longer taken over and its `markers` hold neither `paused` nor `taken over`; the step of the item's state is called at the next pass when the item waits on no decision, and finds a version that is not gated by itself

criteria.action: for any resume of an item that is not taken over, change nothing in the function registered with `Scheduler.OnResume`: read no version, close no decision and write no entry
criteria.contract: a paused item is resumed exactly as package 04 specifies; `nightshift item resume <N>` for an item that is neither paused nor taken over exits 1 with package 04's message `item <N> is not paused`

check.pseudocode: in internal/takeover/giveback_test.go: item 7 paused through package 04's pause route and never taken over; post('/api/v1/items/7/resume'); assert status 200; assert the version stub saw no call and the thread has no given_back entry; post the resume again; assert status 409 and message 'item 7 is not paused'; an item taken over, given back and paused again is resumed with no second given_back entry

criteria.condition: the person pushes to the branch of a taken-over item with a credential of their own and then runs `nightshift item resume <N>`
criteria.action: start nothing for the push, and after the resume have the version the person pushed gated, reviewed and landed as any other version, with no implementer session before the gate
criteria.contract: the hub's checks `nightshift-gate`, `nightshift-review` and `nightshift-release` are `passed` on the person's version and that version is the one landed

execution_paths.title: A note given while the implementer runs reaches a rework

steps.action: runs the implementer session of an item that is `implementing`
runs `nightshift item note <N> "Keep the old log line"`
sends `POST /api/v1/items/<N>/notes` and prints `note 1 added to item <N>`
stores the note and writes it to the item's thread, leaving the session running
finishes and pushes a version
accepts the session and finds the note waiting as a finding of the person and starts a rework with it before the gate
reworks and pushes a new version
marks the note delivered to the rework's session, gates and reviews the new version, and moves the item to `landing`

the note route and the `nightshift item note` command
the scheduler, the implementer's step, the gate and the review of packages 04 and 06
the store, the inbox and the fake hub's forks and changes
a fake `claude` process and the faux reviewer
setup: the daemon started in-process by the helper of internal/daemon/e2e_test.go against internal/hubtest, with a registered workspace `demo`, a fake `claude` executable on PATH that the test scripts, agentkit-go's faux provider for the reviewer, and a gate that passes, as the flows of packages 05 to 07 set them up
an item made `ready` by the planning flow with `--no-plan-approval`
a fake `claude` whose first run waits for a marker file before it pushes, and which records the findings file each rework was given
the fake hub answers the land as pending on an approval, so that the item stays in `landing`
end_state: `nightshift item note` exited 0 while the first session was running, and that session completed, not interrupted
exactly two implementer sessions ran; the second was a rework whose findings file holds `Keep the old log line` as a finding of the person
the fake hub's change has two versions and the checks `nightshift-gate` and `nightshift-review` are `passed` on the second
the item is in `landing` only after the rework
the thread holds the `note` entry and a `note_delivered` entry naming the second session
smoke.pseudocode: in internal/daemon/e2e_test.go: d = startDaemon(cfg); item = a ready item; eventually one implementer session runs; assert cli.Run(['item','note',N,'Keep the old log line']) == 0; create the marker file; eventually item.state == 'landing'; assert len(fakeHub.Sessions(archetype implementer)) == 2; assert fakeClaude.reworkFindings[0] contains 'Keep the old log line'; assert the first session's outcome == 'completed'; assert len(fakeHub.Change(n).versions) == 2; assert the thread has entries of kind note and note_delivered

execution_paths.title: A note withdraws a landing that waits for an approval

steps.action: reports `nightshift-release` as passed and asks the hub to land the item's version
answers that the land is pending on an approval
opens an `approval` decision; the item stays in `landing`
runs `nightshift item note <N> "Do not touch deploy/"`
has the landing withdrawn: reports `nightshift-release` as `failed` with the summary `note from the owner` to the hub
records the failed check on the version
stores the note, closes the `approval` decision as `superseded by a note` and starts a rework with the note
reworks and pushes a new version
gates the new version and runs the review
agrees

the inbox and the fake hub's changes, checks and policy

the state PATH-1 ends in: an item in `landing` whose land the fake hub answered as pending on an approval, with the `approval` decision open
end_state: `nightshift item note` exited 0

execution_paths.title: The person takes an item over from a decision, pushes and gives it back

steps.action: fails twice in a row for the same step
opens a `session_failed` decision whose options hold `take_over`
runs `nightshift decide <id> --option take_over`
reads the change's version from the hub, holds the item, and writes the fork's git URL and the branch to the thread
prints the item with the marker `taken over` for `nightshift item show <N>`
pushes a commit to the branch of the fork with their own credential
records the push as a new version of the item's change
starts no session and gates nothing while the item is taken over
runs `nightshift item resume <N>`
finds the version newer than at the take-over and ends the take-over; the step of the item's state finds the version not gated, gates it and runs the review
agrees
reports `nightshift-release` and asks the hub to land the person's version
lands the change

external_apis.package: Parley REST API and git smart HTTP (agent-fox-dev/parley, docs/api.md)

symbols.name: git remote of a workspace or fork
symbols.import_path: <hub_url> = <external URL of the hub>/git/<org slug>/<workspace slug>.git
symbols.signature: smart HTTP only; `GET …/info/refs?service=git-upload-pack|git-receive-pack`, `POST …/git-upload-pack`, `POST …/git-receive-pack`; HTTP Basic with the credential as the password and any user name; a PAT needs `git:read` to fetch and `git:write` to push, and write access to the workspace

symbols.name: a push to a change's source branch
symbols.signature: a push to a branch that is the source of a draft or open change records the next version of that change, as part of the push and whoever pushes; versions are numbered from 1; moving the branch to the current head records nothing; the hub prints `remote: change <slug>#<number> version <n>`

symbols.name: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/changes/{number}
symbols.signature: 200 with the change object {workspace_slug, number, state, source: {workspace_slug, branch}, version: int (the current version), head_sha, landing, landed, …}; `slug` is the workspace the change belongs to, a fork's parent

symbols.name: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}
symbols.signature: 200 with the workspace object, whose `hub_url` is the git remote of the workspace on the hub; read by package 05's change service, whose Record.GitURL this package prints

symbols.name: PUT /api/v1/workspaces/{slug}/changes/{number}/checks/{name}
symbols.signature: scope checks:write; body {status: pending|passed|failed (required), version (default the current one), summary (at most 2,000 characters), url, details}; one result per version and name, a report replaces the earlier one; 200 with the check; called by package 07's Withdraw, not by this package

external_apis.package: github.com/agent-fox-dev/nightshift/internal/plan and internal/change (package 05, read in .specs/05_planning as a draft)

symbols.name: plan.Service.AddFinding
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) AddFinding(ctx context.Context, item int, text string) error; for an item of kind defect or change_request in new, planning or awaiting_approval: stores the text as a pending finding of the person (id p<n>), interrupts no session, hands it to the planner's next revision, and runs one revision for the pending findings alone when a review agrees; plan.ErrInvalid for an empty text, plan.ErrNotPlanning for another state or a spec item

symbols.name: plan.Service.Revise
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) Revise(ctx context.Context, item int, comment string) error; for an item in awaiting_approval: calls the functions registered with RegisterPrepare, stores the comment as a pending finding of the person and moves the item to planning; plan.ErrNotAwaiting, plan.ErrInvalid for an empty comment

symbols.name: change.Service.Get
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, item int) (Record, error); Record has Item, Workspace, Fork, GitURL, Branch, Generation, Change (0 while no change is open), ChangeRef and ChangeURL; change.ErrNotFound for an item with no fork

symbols.name: plan.Service.PendingFindings
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) PendingFindings(ctx context.Context, item int) (int, error); NEW, added by task 2 of this package: the number of the item's pending findings of the person, 0 for an item with no plan

symbols.name: impl.Service.Rework
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) Rework(ctx context.Context, item int, findings []Finding) error; Finding has ID, Source (gate, review, person, health or conflict), Text, File, Line, Criterion, Output, Binding; for an item in ready, implementing, reviewing or landing: stores the findings after those waiting, skips an ID the item already has, sets Binding for the source person, moves a reviewing or landing item to implementing and wakes the scheduler; impl.ErrInvalid, impl.ErrState, item.ErrNotFound

symbols.name: impl.Service.Waiting and History
symbols.signature: Waiting(item) answers the findings not yet given to an accepted rework, in their order; History(item) the ones that were, each with its reply

symbols.name: impl.Service.Version
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) Version(ctx context.Context, item int) (Version, error); the item's change as the hub has it now: Workspace, Change, Number (the current version), HeadSHA, BaseSHA, State, Paths, Requirements, Overlaps

symbols.name: the step of an implementing item
symbols.signature: starts a rework when findings wait and the package has no open task, before it evaluates or gates; evaluates and gates a current version that has no gate verdict, a person's push among them, with no session; the reviewing step moves an item whose current version is not gated to implementing

symbols.name: land.Service.Withdraw
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) Withdraw(ctx context.Context, item int, summary string) error; waits until no land of the item is being answered, then reports nightshift-release as failed with the summary; land.ErrLanded when the change has landed or lands meanwhile; another error for an item that is not landing

symbols.name: land.Service.AddCondition
symbols.signature: func (s *Service) AddCondition(name string, fn func(ctx context.Context, item int) bool); a further landing condition, evaluated after `paused`; an item for which fn answers false does not land, and nightshift-release is reported failed with the name

symbols.name: the step of a landing item
symbols.signature: moves an item whose current version has no passed nightshift-gate or nightshift-review of its own, or whose land the hub answers 409 version_mismatch, to implementing
